title: a16z speedrun SR008
description: a16z's 12-week startup program, in person in San Francisco. It invests up to $1M in each accepted company, plus $10M+ in partner credits. SR008 runs from February 1 to April 18, 2027; applications are open October 12 through November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT.
reward: Up to $1M in funding and $10M+ in credits
summary: up to $1M · closes Nov 1, 11:59 PM PT
setup: start the application with your email
rules: SR008 applications are open October 12 through November 1, 2026 at 11:59 PM PT. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis; miss the window and you are considered for the next residency.
SR008 runs from February 1 to April 18, 2027 in San Francisco, with Demo Day on April 13. In-person attendance is required.
The program runs for 12 intensive weeks and requires a full-time commitment.
For early-stage founders; companies that have already raised capital can apply.
For teams that can build and iterate on their product internally, usually with a technical co-founder.
Deal: up to $1M. $500K for 10% upfront on a SAFE, and up to another $500K in your next qualifying round ($2M+) within 18 months.
